title.en-US: Profitable companies: do forecasts beat last year’s profit?
title.zh-CN: 最终盈利的公司，券商预测比沿用去年利润更准吗？

metric.en-US: Median absolute error / absolute realized profit; lower is closer
metric.zh-CN: 误差中位数，数值越低，预测越接近实际利润

context.en-US: 2015–2025. Identical stocks in each paired comparison. Paired stock-years at 30 / 90 / 180 days: 18225 / 18488 / 18432; missing baselines: 682 / 719 / 744. Absolute realized profit above CNY10m. Prior-year values must be disclosed by the cutoff. Historical versions remain unverified.
context.zh-CN: 2015年至2025年。每个期限内，两种方法比较同一批股票年度。30天、90天、180天的配对样本数分别为18225 / 18488 / 18432，缺少基准的样本数分别为682 / 719 / 744。只计算实际盈利或亏损绝对值超过1000万元的公司。上一年财报须在截止日前公布，历史数值版本仍未核实。

interpretation.en-US: The pooled medians and the median company-level paired improvement are different statistics. Read the paired-improvement chart before comparing horizons.
interpretation.zh-CN: 两列分别计算各自的误差中位数。判断券商是否更准，还要看逐家公司配对后的结果。下方的配对改善图保留了这个比较。

title.en-US: Profitable companies: does wider coverage mean smaller errors?
title.zh-CN: 最终盈利的公司，多家券商覆盖的误差更小吗？

metric.en-US: Raw median relative errors by institutions with a recent eligible forecast
metric.zh-CN: 按近期有效预测的券商家数分组，比较误差中位数

context.en-US: All broker/outcome matches, including missing baselines. Groups differ in company characteristics. Counts by one / two / three-plus institutions, each ordered 30 / 90 / 180 days: 4176 / 3945 / 4010 / 2720 / 2651 / 2682 / 12011 / 12611 / 12484.
context.zh-CN: 使用全部合格预测和财报配对，包括缺少去年利润基准的公司。各组公司的特点不同。按一家、两家、至少三家券商分组，每组按30天、90天、180天排列的样本数为4176 / 3945 / 4010 / 2720 / 2651 / 2682 / 12011 / 12611 / 12484。

interpretation.en-US: Raw group differences do not isolate the effect of analyst counts. Compare the profit and industry controls as well.
interpretation.zh-CN: 这张图只展示分组差异。利润水平和行业等特点也会影响误差，请接着看控制这些特点后的图。

title.en-US: Profitable companies: compare coverage after controls
title.zh-CN: 最终盈利的公司，考虑利润和行业后结果怎样？

metric.en-US: Change in log(1 + relative error) versus one institution; zero means no estimated difference
metric.zh-CN: 相对一家券商的误差差异，使用对数转换后的误差，零表示估计没有差异

context.en-US: Separate regressions at each cutoff control log absolute realized profit, year and industry. Company-clustered 95% intervals. This is one descriptive model, using later-realized profit and reconstructed industries; coefficients are not raw error percentage points. Rows: 17899 / 18182 / 17982; missing industry: 1008 / 1025 / 1194.
context.zh-CN: 每个期限单独比较，并控制实际利润绝对值、年份和行业。细线表示按公司聚类计算的95％区间。这是一个描述性模型，使用了后来实现的利润和重建行业。系数单位与原始误差百分比不同。样本数为17899 / 18182 / 17982，缺少行业的数量为1008 / 1025 / 1194。

interpretation.en-US: Negative coefficients would accompany smaller transformed errors. This specification does not support a general accuracy benefit from wider coverage; it does not establish causation.
interpretation.zh-CN: 负值才表示更多覆盖伴随更小的转换后误差。当前模型没有支持多家覆盖普遍更准，也不能据此推断覆盖家数导致了误差变化。

title.en-US: Does the paired broker advantage persist?
title.zh-CN: 逐家公司比较后，券商预测改善了多少？

metric.en-US: Mean annual median paired error improvement; positive favors the broker
metric.zh-CN: 先逐家公司计算误差改善，再取各年中位数的平均，正值表示券商更准

context.en-US: Baseline error minus broker error, measured on paired stock-years. Eleven target years, 2000 year-block resamples, descriptive 95% intervals. The intervals describe the mean annual median, not pooled medians. Few year blocks, repeated companies and serial dependence limit precision; no multiple-comparison correction.
context.zh-CN: 每家公司用去年利润基准的误差减去券商误差，再按年汇总。共11个目标年度，按年份重抽样2000次，细线表示描述性95％区间。区间对应各年中位数的平均，与前图的整体中位数不同。年份较少，同一公司会重复出现，跨年也可能相关，区间精度有限，尚未校正多项比较。

interpretation.en-US: Profitable-company advantages are clearer at 30 and 90 days. The 180-day interval includes zero. Loss-making-company forecasts fare worse at 90 and 180 days.
interpretation.zh-CN: 盈利公司在30天和90天的改善较清楚，180天的区间跨过零，优势还不确定。亏损公司在90天和180天表现更差。

metric.en-US: Missing endpoint observations by diagnostic evidence

context.en-US: There are 11,498 missing endpoints across 8,399 stock-month rows. One stock-month can have two missing endpoints.
context.zh-CN: 8399条股票月份记录中有11498个缺失价格端点。同一条记录可能同时缺入场和出场价格。

interpretation.en-US: Suspension records overlap most missing endpoints. Delisting data is diagnostic evidence; no terminal value was filled.

context.en-US: Years refer to portfolio formation dates. The suspension source ends September 17, 2026.
context.zh-CN: 年份按组合汇总日计算。停牌数据覆盖到2026年9月17日。

interpretation.en-US: 395 unresolved endpoints fall within suspension-source coverage and 2 fall after it. The 20-case API probe returned no quotes and is not representative.
interpretation.zh-CN: 395个未确认端点位于停牌数据覆盖期内，2个在覆盖期后。另抽查20个案例均未返回报价，这组抽查不代表全部缺失案例。

metric.zh-CN: 研报日期口径188个月内的股票月份记录数

context.en-US: Rows can repeat a company across months. Blank or non-positive reported PE and other missing inputs are excluded before looking at future returns.
context.zh-CN: 研报日期口径覆盖188个月，共有271841条股票月份记录，估值配对样本保留219014条。同一家公司会在不同月份重复出现。市盈率为空或不为正、其他必要字段缺失的记录都在查看未来收益前剔除。

interpretation.en-US: The paired valuation analysis retains 219,014 of 271,841 source stock-month rows. Excluded PE rows include loss-making companies and other vendor blanks.
interpretation.zh-CN: 估值配对分析保留219014条，共271841条原始股票月份记录。市盈率剔除项既包括亏损公司，也包括供应商未提供数值的情况。

title.en-US: Retrieve and verify the history
title.zh-CN: 拉取历史记录并核对完整性

question.en-US: What does the source actually cover?

finding.en-US: 191 monthly partitions contain 2,749,081 report/period records; all payload hashes were checked.
finding.zh-CN: 191个月共2749081条研报预测记录，逐月载荷哈希已核对。

decision.en-US: Keep vendor records private and retain annual coverage.
decision.zh-CN: 原始研报留在数据平台，页面展示逐年覆盖。

title.en-US: Check historical availability
title.zh-CN: 核对历史数据何时可见

question.en-US: Can old report dates establish original availability?
question.zh-CN: 旧研报的日期能支持多长的历史检验？

finding.en-US: 2011 provider updates are in 2022; the provider-clock cohort begins in May 2022.
finding.zh-CN: 2011年记录的供应商更新时间在2022年，供应商时间口径从2022年5月起有足够样本。

decision.en-US: Retain separate full-history and matched-clock comparisons.
decision.zh-CN: 分别保留完整历史结果和同样本时间口径对照。

title.en-US: Compare the four fixed scores
title.zh-CN: 比较四类固定排序

question.en-US: Which association remains after exposure controls?
question.zh-CN: 扣除行业和市值影响后，哪些关系还存在？

finding.en-US: Adjusted report-clock profit-revision RankIC is 0.00149; forward yield is 0.03649.
finding.zh-CN: 研报日期口径中，上调幅度的调整后排名相关系数为0.00149，预期盈利相对市值为0.03649。

decision.en-US: Keep all definitions as research candidates; no trading rule is promoted.
decision.zh-CN: 四类定义继续保留为研究候选，交易规则仍需验证。

title.en-US: Retain missing-return and cost limits
title.zh-CN: 保留价格缺失和费用限制

question.en-US: Can the return diagnostic support an investable strategy?
question.zh-CN: 现有收益结果离实际交易还有多远？

finding.en-US: Adjusted spread samples have only 46–54 complete months. All 10-bps net-spread intervals include zero.
finding.zh-CN: 调整后的分组收益各有46至54个完整月份。单边费用0.10％时，四项净收益差的不确定区间都包含零。

decision.en-US: Resolve terminal events and observe genuinely later snapshots before promotion.
decision.zh-CN: 继续核对终止事件，并积累新观察日版本及随后结果。

title.en-US: Compare forecasts with reported valuation
title.zh-CN: 把预测盈利和已披露盈利放在同样本比较

question.en-US: Does forecast earnings yield improve stock ranking beyond reported earnings yield?
question.zh-CN: 预测盈利收益率比已披露盈利收益率多提供多少排序信息？

finding.en-US: The paired forecast-minus-reported RankIC intervals include zero. The adjusted forecast residual has a positive historical association, which is descriptive.
finding.zh-CN: 预测减已披露盈利的配对区间都包含零。调整后的预测排序残差与随后收益呈正相关，这只是历史样本描述。

decision.en-US: Keep the forecast residual as a research candidate and collect genuinely dated snapshots before testing future returns.
decision.zh-CN: 保留预测排序残差作为研究候选，积累带真实日期的快照后再检验未来收益。

title.en-US: Classify missing prices
title.zh-CN: 给缺失价格分类

question.en-US: Do missing rows represent suspensions, listing dates or unresolved gaps?
question.zh-CN: 缺失记录对应停牌、上市时间还是未确认缺口？

finding.en-US: 10,764 of 11,498 endpoints overlap suspension records. The audit did not fill terminal settlement values.
finding.zh-CN: 11498个缺失端点中有10764个对应停牌记录。核查没有补入终止结算价值。

decision.en-US: Keep incomplete months out of net-spread estimates and retain unresolved cases as missing.
decision.zh-CN: 净收益差只使用价格完整的月份，未确认案例继续标为缺失。

period.en-US: Registered for prospective collection, starting November 2026
period.zh-CN: 登记前瞻采集规则，2026年11月开始

title.en-US: Start immutable daily snapshots
title.zh-CN: 开始保存不可变的每日快照

question.en-US: Can stored forecasts be evaluated using only information completed before each decision date?
question.zh-CN: 能否只用决策日前已完成保存的预测检验？

finding.en-US: The daily job and cutoff protocol are registered. No prospective forecasts or future returns are available yet.
finding.zh-CN: 每日采集和时间截止规则已经登记，目前还没有前瞻预测或未来收益结果。

decision.en-US: Use a snapshot only when its recorded completion time precedes the decision cutoff. Do not backfill missed observation days.
decision.zh-CN: 只使用记录的完成时间早于决策截止时点的快照。漏掉的观测日不补造。

next_question.en-US: Do genuinely observed monthly snapshots add value when compared with reported valuation on identical stocks and dates?
next_question.zh-CN: 在同一批股票和日期上，真实按月保存的预测快照能否比已披露估值多提供信息？

title.en-US: What do these results tell us?
title.zh-CN: 这些结果怎么理解？

verdict.en-US: Near year-end, forecasts help estimate profitable companies’ annual earnings. Reliable stock selection still needs more evidence.
verdict.zh-CN: 临近年底，券商预测能帮助估计盈利公司这一年赚了多少。用它稳定选出收益更高的股票，还需要更多证据。

legend_note.en-US: Use the legend buttons to show or hide a series. Axes rescale to visible series. Exact tables retain every series.
legend_note.zh-CN: 点击图例可以显示或隐藏一组数据，坐标轴会随显示的数据调整，精确数值表始终保留全部数据。

title.en-US: Can we use it to select stocks now?
title.zh-CN: 现在能靠它选股吗？

paragraphs.en-US: Some forecast-based rankings accompany later returns in historical samples. Profit-revision relationships weaken after industry and size controls. Forecast earnings yield has a clearer association, but its advantage over reported earnings yield remains uncertain.
paragraphs.zh-CN: 部分预测指标在历史样本中与后续收益有关。预测上调幅度在考虑行业和市值后关系较弱。用预测利润衡量股票贵不贵，关联更清楚一些，但它比已经公布的盈利多提供多少选股帮助，还没有明确证据。

paragraphs.en-US: Rank correlation compares two orderings: one by the forecast score and one by subsequent stock returns. A positive value means higher scores tend to accompany higher later returns. Different ways of constructing a consensus score have different evidence.
paragraphs.zh-CN: 图里的排名相关系数，衡量两种排序有多接近。一种按指标分数高低排，另一种按随后收益高低排。正值表示高分股票后来往往表现更好。一致预期可以做成不同的选股分数，各种分数的证据强弱也不同。

paragraphs.en-US: All reviewed intervals for the original cost-adjusted spread diagnostics include zero. Original provider vintages, missing terminal prices and actual trading conditions remain unresolved. Predicting profits more accurately does not establish higher investment returns. Current findings support further research, and have not established a dependable trading rule.
paragraphs.zh-CN: 高低分组收益差，就是高分组收益减去低分组收益。原研究扣费后的差值区间都包含零，历史数据版本、部分期末价格和真实交易条件还没有核实。预测利润更准，也不能保证买股票多赚钱。现有结果支持继续研究，距离稳定可用的选股规则还有证据缺口。

title.en-US: Forecasts help more near year-end
title.zh-CN: 临近年底，盈利公司的预测更有帮助

paragraphs.en-US: The simple baseline carries last year’s annual profit forward as this year’s forecast. Among companies that ultimately earned more than CNY10m, broker and baseline median errors are 13.5% and 27.4% at the roughly one-month cutoff. At three months they are 19.3% and 27.8%.
paragraphs.zh-CN: 我们用一个简单方法作比较，把公司去年赚的钱直接当作今年的预测。对最终盈利超过1000万元的公司，年底前约一个月，券商预测和简单方法的误差中位数分别为13.5％和27.4％。提前约三个月时，两者分别为19.3％和27.8％。

paragraphs.en-US: A 13.5% error corresponds to CNY13.5m for a CNY100m realized profit. This illustrates the scale of the ratio, not a prediction for an individual company. Half-year paired comparisons do not establish a clear broker advantage. Forecasts nearer year-end can draw on more quarterly reports.
paragraphs.zh-CN: 用实际赚了1亿元来理解，13.5％的误差相当于差了约1350万元。这只是帮助理解比例，每家公司的误差会不同。提前约半年时，逐家公司配对后的比较还看不出明确优势。临近年底，分析师已经能看到更多季度财报。

title.en-US: Loss-making companies need a separate view
title.zh-CN: 亏损公司的预测更难用

paragraphs.en-US: For companies that ultimately lost more than CNY10m, forecasts at the three- and six-month cutoffs perform worse than carrying forward last year’s profit. At one month the improvement remains uncertain.
paragraphs.zh-CN: 对最终亏损超过1000万元的公司，提前约三个月或半年时，券商预测比沿用去年利润更差。到年底前约一个月，改善仍不确定。

paragraphs.en-US: Profit and loss groups use later-realized outcomes. They help describe where errors occur and cannot serve as a ready-made screen at the forecast cutoff.
paragraphs.zh-CN: 这里按后来实际盈利还是亏损分组，帮助我们看清误差发生在哪里。预测截止日还不知道最终结果，不能直接照这个分组筛股票。

title.en-US: More coverage is not an accuracy guarantee
title.zh-CN: 多家券商覆盖，也需要看公司特点

paragraphs.en-US: Raw profitable-company groups with three or more institutions have smaller median errors than the one-institution group. Once realized profit level, year and industry enter the chosen model, that apparent advantage does not persist.
paragraphs.zh-CN: 原始分组里，至少三家券商覆盖的盈利公司，误差中位数比只有一家覆盖的公司低。把利润水平、年份和行业放进当前模型后，这个优势没有保留下来。

paragraphs.en-US: Institution counts remain useful context. The present sample does not justify a rule that three or more forecasts are sufficiently reliable. The controls use realized profits, and the association is descriptive rather than causal.
paragraphs.zh-CN: 覆盖家数可以帮助理解样本特点。现有结果不足以支持至少三家覆盖就更可靠这样的筛选门槛。模型使用后来实现的利润，只能描述关联，无法说明覆盖家数导致了什么变化。

title.en-US: What still needs verification?
title.zh-CN: 这些结果还需要怎样验证？

paragraphs.en-US: Historical forecasts were retrieved later. Their original unchanged availability is unverified. The profit-accuracy work covers 2015–2025; stock-return evidence has its own periods and cohorts. Compare each chart within its stated sample.
paragraphs.zh-CN: 历史预测是后来补拉的，我们还不能确认每个数值在当年是否已经原样可见。预测准确度研究覆盖2015年至2025年，选股研究有各自的区间和样本，请按每张图说明的范围理解。

paragraphs.en-US: Immutable daily observations started on November 2, 2026. Future evaluation will use preserved observations and later outcomes. No prospective formation score or forward-return evaluation has yet been recorded in this evidence release.
paragraphs.zh-CN: 2026年11月2日已经开始保存每天实际拿到的快照。后续会用当时留存的预测，检验它之后真正发生的结果。本版证据还没有前瞻形成分数或后续收益评估。
